text:
Samantha P: OK team — Datadog + OTEL demo runbook sync. Need to lock the on‑prem demo flow and who owns what before next Friday. Quick agenda: demo infra, tracing sampling, dashboard tiles, marketing assets, joint announcement timing.

Kevin L: I can take infra + tracing config. main ask: how to sample traces from high‑throughput GPU inference without losing latency hotspots. thinking adaptive sampling + head‑span capture.

Maria R: I’ll own dashboards and slides for the customer demo. Can someone share the sample traces/IDs we want highlighted? ideally one long‑tail latency case + normal throughput.

Samantha P: @Kevin can you wire up a synthetic generator that hits the dedicated pool with varied seq lengths? we need 1) end‑to‑end traces in OTLP, 2) span attributes for model, seq_len, quantization, and 3) errors/timeout markers.

Kevin L: Yep. I’ll add a small script and a k8s job. plan to push an OTLP collector config that adds resource attributes: service=redwood-inference, environment=demo, model_variant. Will also include a sampler config: probability 0.02 + rate limiting for fast paths, head‑span keep for >500ms.

Ashok (deploy-bot): deploy-bot: demo-cluster-eta: cluster/demo-gpu created in us-west-2 (id: demo-2195).

Maria R: Perfect — once we have traces, I’ll build a Datadog dashboard tile set: request rate, p50/p95/p99, KV cache hit rate, and a trace flamegraph panel. Also want an A/B comparison tile when we flip quantization.

Samantha P: On the joint announcement: legal asked for the draft by Tue EOD. @Jules M you good to coordinate wording? We need to confirm co-branding guidelines with Datadog too.

Jules M: Yup — I’ll draft a short blog + press release bullet points. question: do we want a co‑hosted webinar? if so, need speaker list and ~4 slides.

Kevin L: Webinar good. Technical bullets: 1) tracing LLM inference across private clouds, 2) sampling approach for high TPS, 3) dashboarding for cost/latency tradeoffs, 4) quick checklist for SI customers.

Maria R: Also need a marketplace tile screenshot for the private offering. @Samantha can you provide a VPN or a masked demo endpoint for marketing to screenshot?

Samantha P: I’ll provision a demo endpoint with basic auth and ephemeral creds for screenshots. Ops: ensure keys are rotated and audit logs enabled. Note: private deployments require KMS notes in the marketplace listing.

Kevin L: FYI — for OTEL collector config we’re adding an attribute mapping for model.id and model.quant. Will call out in runbook how to instrument the runtime to emit these. snippet I’ll push:
```
export OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service=redwood-inference,env=demo
collector-config: receivers: otlp: protocols: grpc/http processors: batch, probabilistic_sampler
```

Samantha P: Great. Runbook action items (assign):
- Kevin: synthetic trace generator + collector config + sampler doc (due Wed)
- Maria: dashboard tiles + A/B quant comparison mockups (due Thu)
- Jules: draft announcement + webinar plan (due Tue EOD)
- Legal/Product: review co‑marketing wording (Tues)
- Ops: demo endpoint + creds + KMS audit (Wed)

Jules M: Noted. Also need an approvals matrix for Datadog marketing. I’ll ping our partner manager to request logos and co‑promo OK.

Ashok (deploy-bot): deploy-bot: job/demo-synthetic-traces started (job-id: synth-993).

Kevin L: synth job running, sending traces to collector endpoint. sample rate ~0.02 initial. I’ll bump to 0.05 for a short window to capture a few p99s for screenshots.

Maria R: Received a handful of demo traces. Building flamegraph now. Can you tag one trace ID we should use in slides?

Kevin L: Use trace id 0x9f2b31 for the long‑tail example (seq_len=4096, quant=8bit). I’ll redact PII and export span JSON.

Samantha P: Heads up — legal flagged GDPR language for EU customers on the marketplace tile. Add a short note: "Data forwarding for observability is optional and controlled by customer".

Jules M: Good catch. I’ll add that to the draft and include Datadog's privacy contact.

Samantha P: Final: let’s do a dry run Wed 10am PT with slides + live trace demo. Kevin/Maria/Jules please be there. I’ll invite the Datadog PM and our SI lead.

Kevin L: Confirmed. I’ll have the collector config PR open and a link to synthetic job logs.

Maria R: Confirmed — will also prep a short video of the dashboard interactions in case live trace lags.

Jules M: I’ll circulate the draft announcement by Tue morning for comments.

Samantha P: thanks all — moving to action items. :rocket:
